modelResponse.mechanism: Caffeine-induced increased sympathetic tone and catecholamine release triggering a re-entrant circuit in the atria or AV node.

rejectedAlternatives.why: Abrupt onset and absence of discernible P-waves at a rate of 190 bpm is inconsistent with sinus rhythm.

recommendedActions: Perform vagal maneuvers (e.g., Valsalva maneuver) to attempt termination of rhythm.
Monitor vital signs and ECG continuously.
Avoid further caffeine or stimulant intake.
Assess for chest pain or symptomatic changes.
uncertainty: Specific type of SVT (e.g., AVNRT vs AVRT) cannot be definitively distinguished without further P-wave visualization or post-vagal maneuver analysis.
